research.section.title: Scientific Parameters of the Platform
research.section.caption: The platform combines public observation, methodological curation and comparative analysis. This layer makes explicit the variables, evidence and protocols that provide scientific consistency for the longitudinal monitoring of audiovisual archives.
research.question.label: Provisional research question
research.parameters.summary: The platform examines the digital visibility of audiovisual archives through verifiable parameters: completeness, collection route, access, visibility, stability, territory, language, aggregation and historical continuity.
